entities.name: pulsed electromagnetic field therapy
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Pulsed electromagnetic field therapy, also known as low field magnetic stimulation (LFMS) is the use of electromagnetic fields in an attempt to heal non-union fractures and depression. By 2007, the FDA had cleared several such stimulation devices.
